summary: scripts/review: a harness may declare how its reviewer reads files ("reads": "tools" or "shell" in .st/review-harness.json). codex reads through a shell in its read-only permissions profile, so its prompt now says it has a read-only shell confined to the checkout, not that it has no shell; before, codex took that literally, read no file but the diff and answered CHANGES for lack of reading.

replay.detail: scripts/review, .st/review-harness.json, scripts/review-test and the README (local review tooling) only; no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change.

schema.detail: scripts/review, .st/review-harness.json, scripts/review-test and the README (local review tooling) only; no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change.

rules.detail: scripts/review, .st/review-harness.json, scripts/review-test and the README (local review tooling) only; no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change.

compatibility.detail: An optional harness key, default unchanged (tools, no shell); an unknown value fails the review before the agent runs.

recovery.detail: Revert; the review reads fewer files with codex again.
